metadata.name: vortex_sowellian
metadata.description: Vortexes Sowellian governance: approved success criteria, a YES/NO market, oracle or challengeable human resolution.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Cancels a proposal before it runs: its proposer while the approval
vote is open, or the DAO through a proposal any time before execution.
Positions are refunded and the bond returned.

instructions.name: cast_adjudication_vote
docs: Votes Success or Failure in a challenged resolution, weighted by deposit.

instructions.name: cast_approval_vote
docs: Votes on whether the proposal and its criteria go ahead, weighted by deposit.

instructions.name: challenge_resolution
docs: Disputes the proposed outcome, posting the challenge bond. Starts the adjudication vote.

instructions.name: claim_bond
docs: The proposer, resolver or challenger takes back what they're owed from this proposal.

instructions.name: claim_position
docs: Pays out a position: winners split the whole pool pro rata; on a void
or cancelled proposal everyone gets their stake back.

instructions.name: confirm_execution
docs: The hub's check before it runs a proposal (CONFIRM_EXECUTION): after
the positions window and the timelock, within the execution period.
Starts the measurement period.

instructions.name: finalize_adjudication
docs: Settles a challenged resolution once the vote is over. Success needs
quorum and the threshold; anything else is a failure. Anyone.

instructions.name: finalize_approval
docs: Settles the approval vote once it's over. Anyone.

instructions.name: finalize_unchallenged
docs: Nobody challenged in time: the proposed outcome stands. Anyone.

instructions.name: init_governance
docs: Sets up a hub DAO here: rules, token, the deposit vault and the escrow
for bonds and positions. The creator right after create_dao, or the
treasury when switching here.

instructions.name: propose
docs: Proposes `instructions` with their success criteria, posting the
proposal bond. `id` must be proposal_count + 1.

instructions.name: propose_resolution
docs: Proposes the outcome of a human-track proposal, posting the resolution bond.

instructions.name: resolve_via_oracle
docs: Resolves an oracle-track proposal with a Pyth price. Anyone, once the
measurement period is over.

instructions.name: sweep_to_treasury
docs: Sends forfeited bonds to the treasury's token account. Anyone.

instructions.name: take_position
docs: Backs YES (the criteria will be met) or NO with `amount` of the DAO's token.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Replaces the rules (only through a passed proposal).

instructions.name: void_expired
docs: An approved proposal nobody ran within its execution period: void,
positions refunded, bond returned. Anyone.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraws a deposit once the votes it was used in have closed.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Oracle track: the Pyth price feed id.

fields.name: target_value
docs: Oracle track: the target, 18-decimal fixed point.

fields.name: target_is_minimum
docs: Success at or above the target (true), or at or below it (false).

fields.name: measurement_period
docs: Seconds after execution before the outcome can be resolved.

fields.name: governance_program
docs: The governance program running the DAO now.

fields.name: governance
docs: The DAO's account in that program: `[GOVERNANCE_SEED, dao]` there.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Starts at 1 and goes up with every switch. Proposals only run in
the epoch they were made in.

fields.name: vault
docs: Members' deposits (voting weight).

fields.name: escrow
docs: Bonds and positions.

fields.name: owed_treasury
docs: Forfeited bonds waiting to be swept to the treasury.

types.name: Phase
docs: Same order as the EVM contract's Phase (ResolutionPending is unused there too).

fields.name: approval_quorum_base
docs: All deposits when proposed: the approval vote's quorum base.

fields.name: adjudication_quorum_base
docs: All deposits when challenged: the adjudication vote's quorum base.

fields.name: owed_proposer
docs: Bonds waiting to be claimed.

types.name: ProposalCore
docs: The first field of every governance program's proposal account, right
after Anchor's 8-byte discriminator, so the hub can read what to run
from any model.

fields.name: hub_dao
docs: The hub DAO this proposal belongs to.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The hub epoch it was made in; only runs while that epoch lasts.

fields.name: instructions
docs: What it does when it executes, signed by the treasury.

fields.name: observed
docs: The price, 18-decimal fixed point.

fields.name: proposal_bond
docs: Posted with every proposal (raw tokens); lost to the treasury if the approval vote fails.

fields.name: positions_window
docs: How long positions can be taken after approval.

fields.name: execution_timelock
docs: Wait after the positions window before the proposal can run.

fields.name: execution_period
docs: How long after that it can still run.

fields.name: max_oracle_staleness
docs: Oldest Pyth price (seconds) an oracle resolution accepts.

types.name: StoredAccountMeta
docs: One account an instruction touches.

types.name: StoredInstruction
docs: One instruction a proposal runs when it executes.

types.name: VoteChoice
docs: Same order as the EVM contracts' VoteType.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: One per member per proposal per vote, so nobody votes twice.
